description: Osimertinib can be used, within its marketing authorisation, as an option to treat unresectable locally advanced (stage 3) non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults when the tumours have epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 19 deletions or exon 21 L858R substitution mutations, and the cancer has not progressed during or after platinum-based chemoradiotherapy.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended osimertinib, within its marketing authorisation, as an option to treat unresectable locally advanced (stage 3) non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in adults whose tumours have EGFR exon 19 deletions or exon 21 (L858R) substitution mutations, when the cancer has not progressed during or after platinum-based chemoradiotherapy. Osimertinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
